K-1-1.q: True or false: God is our Father. He is good, and he loves every one of us. He is always with us.
Which word fits? “The one true God, who made everything out of love and is always with us.”
K-1-1.why: God: The one true God, who made everything out of love and is always with us.

K-1-1.q: Catechism 239: “God's parental tenderness can also be expressed by the image of motherhood, which emphasizes God's immanence, the intimacy between _____ and creature.”
K-1-1.why: CCC 239: “God's parental tenderness can also be expressed by the image of motherhood, which emphasizes God's immanence, the intimacy between Creator and creature.”

K-1-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “God is our loving Father” teaches? “A little girl who loved God as her Father and trusted him in everything.”
K-1-1.why: Thérèse of Lisieux: a little girl who loved God as her Father and trusted him in everything.

K-1-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “God is our loving Father”?
K-1-1.why: Matthew 6:9 is the passage for this lesson.

K-1-2.q: True or false: God made the sky, the sea, the animals and the plants. He made them because he is good. He looked and said, “It is good.
Which word fits? “Everything God made, from nothing, because he is good.”
K-1-2.why: creation: Everything God made, from nothing, because he is good.

K-1-2.q: Which word fits? “God, who made everything that exists.”
K-1-2.why: Creator: God, who made everything that exists.

K-1-2.q: Catechism 279: “the profession of faith takes them up when it confesses that God the Father almighty is "_____ of heaven and earth" (Apostles' Creed), "of all that is, seen and unseen" (Nicene Creed).”
K-1-2.why: CCC 279: “the profession of faith takes them up when it confesses that God the Father almighty is "Creator of heaven and earth" (Apostles' Creed), "of all that is, seen and unseen" (Nicene Creed).”

K-1-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “God made the world” teaches? “He called the sun, the moon and the animals his brothers and sisters because God made them all.”
K-1-2.why: Francis of Assisi: he called the sun, the moon and the animals his brothers and sisters because God made them all.

K-1-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “God made the world”?
K-1-2.why: Genesis 1:1-25 is the passage for this lesson.

K-1-3.q: True or false: God made me in a special way. I am a person, not a thing. God made me to know him and love him.
Which word fits? “Every person is made like God: able to think, choose and love.”
K-1-3.why: image of God: Every person is made like God: able to think, choose and love.

K-1-3.q: Which word fits? “The great worth every person has because God made and loves them.”
K-1-3.why: dignity: The great worth every person has because God made and loves them.

K-1-3.q: Catechism 355: “"God created man in his own image, in the image of God he created him, male and female he created them." Man occupies a unique place in _____:”
K-1-3.why: CCC 355: “"God created man in his own image, in the image of God he created him, male and female he created them." Man occupies a unique place in creation:”

K-1-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “God made me” teaches? “A boy who loved God and computers and showed that everyone has gifts.”
K-1-3.why: Bl. Carlo Acutis: a boy who loved God and computers and showed that everyone has gifts.

K-1-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “God made me”?
K-1-3.why: Genesis 1:26-31 is the passage for this lesson.

K-2-1.q: True or false: God sent his Son, Jesus, to be a baby. Mary was his mother and Joseph took care of him. Jesus is God, and he is also a real person.
Which word fits? “God the Son becoming man: Jesus is true God and true man.”
K-2-1.why: Incarnation: God the Son becoming man: Jesus is true God and true man.

K-2-1.q: Which word fits? “The Mother of Jesus and so Mother of God; our mother in faith.”
K-2-1.why: Mary: The Mother of Jesus and so Mother of God; our mother in faith.

K-2-1.q: Catechism 527: “This sign prefigures that "circumcision of Christ" which is _____.”
K-2-1.why: CCC 527: “This sign prefigures that "circumcision of Christ" which is Baptism.”

K-2-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Jesus is born” teaches? “He made the first living nativity scene to help people see how Jesus was born.”
K-2-1.why: Francis of Assisi: he made the first living nativity scene to help people see how Jesus was born.

K-2-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Jesus is born”?
K-2-1.why: Luke 2:1-20 is the passage for this lesson.

K-2-2.q: True or false: Jesus loved the children and held them in his arms. Jesus loves you right now.
Which word fits? “A follower and learner of Jesus.”
K-2-2.why: disciple: A follower and learner of Jesus.

K-2-2.q: Catechism 2785: “[The _____ is accomplished] by the contemplation of God alone, and by the warmth of love, through which the soul, molded and directed to love him, speaks very familiarly to God as to its own Father with special devotion.”
K-2-2.why: CCC 2785: “[The prayer is accomplished] by the contemplation of God alone, and by the warmth of love, through which the soul, molded and directed to love him, speaks very familiarly to God as to its own Father with special devotion.”

K-2-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Jesus loves children” teaches? “A young girl who loved Jesus and prayed for her mother.”
K-2-2.why: Bl. Laura Vicuña: a young girl who loved Jesus and prayed for her mother.

K-2-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Jesus loves children”?
K-2-2.why: Mark 10:13-16 is the passage for this lesson.

K-2-3.q: True or false: Jesus helped people who were sick and sad. He still helps us today. We can ask him for help.
Which word fits? “A wonderful sign of God’s power that goes beyond nature.”
K-2-3.why: miracle: A wonderful sign of God’s power that goes beyond nature.

K-2-3.q: Which word fits? “Being thankful for gifts.”
Who is this saint, who lived what “Jesus helps and heals” teaches? “A priest who cared for people with leprosy.”
K-2-3.why: Damien of Molokai: a priest who cared for people with leprosy.

K-2-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Jesus helps and heals”?
K-2-3.why: Mark 1:29-34 is the passage for this lesson.

K-3-1.q: True or false: Mary said yes to God. She is Jesus’ mother and our mother too. She helps us love Jesus.
Which word fits? “The Mother of Jesus and so Mother of God; our mother in faith.”
K-3-1.why: Mary: The Mother of Jesus and so Mother of God; our mother in faith.

K-3-1.q: Catechism 495: “Hence the _____ confesses that Mary is truly "Mother of God" (Theotokos).”
K-3-1.why: CCC 495: “Hence the Church confesses that Mary is truly "Mother of God" (Theotokos).”

K-3-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Mary is Jesus’ mother” teaches? “He said yes when Mary asked him to carry her message.”
K-3-1.why: Juan Diego: he said yes when Mary asked him to carry her message.

K-3-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Mary is Jesus’ mother”?
K-3-1.why: Luke 1:26-38 is the passage for this lesson.

K-3-2.q: True or false: Saints are people who loved God very much. Now they are with God in heaven. They pray for us.
Which word fits? “A holy person who is with God in heaven.”
K-3-2.why: saint: A holy person who is with God in heaven.

K-3-2.q: Which word fits? “Life with God forever, in perfect happiness.”
K-3-2.why: heaven: Life with God forever, in perfect happiness.

K-3-2.q: Catechism 828: “"The saints have always been the source and origin of renewal in the most difficult moments in the _____'s history." Indeed, "holiness is the hidden source and infallible measure of her apostolic activity and missionary zeal."”
K-3-2.why: CCC 828: “"The saints have always been the source and origin of renewal in the most difficult moments in the Church's history." Indeed, "holiness is the hidden source and infallible measure of her apostolic activity and missionary zeal."”

K-3-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The saints are God’s friends” teaches? “A kind bishop who gave gifts secretly to people in need.”
K-3-2.why: Nicholas: a kind bishop who gave gifts secretly to people in need.

K-3-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The saints are God’s friends”?
K-3-2.why: Revelation 7:9 is the passage for this lesson.

K-3-3.q: True or false: Angels are God’s helpers. Each one of us has a guardian angel who watches over us.
Which word fits? “A spiritual being without a body who serves God and watches over us.”
K-3-3.why: angel: A spiritual being without a body who serves God and watches over us.

K-3-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Angels help us” teaches? “He said, “Our guardian angel is always with us,” and asked people to send their angel.”
K-3-3.why: Padre Pio: he said, “Our guardian angel is always with us,” and asked people to send their angel.

K-3-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Angels help us”?
K-3-3.why: Psalm 91:11 is the passage for this lesson.

K-4-1.q: True or false: The Church is God’s family. We are baptized and belong to it. Our priest and our parish help us follow Jesus.
Which word fits? “The people God gathers in Christ, who share one faith and one baptism.”
K-4-1.why: Church: The people God gathers in Christ, who share one faith and one baptism.

K-4-1.q: Which word fits? “The local community of Catholics with their own church and priest.”
K-4-1.why: parish: The local community of Catholics with their own church and priest.

K-4-1.q: Catechism 751: “The word "_____" (Latin ecclesia, from the Greek ek-ka-lein, to "call out of") means a convocation or an assembly.”
K-4-1.why: CCC 751: “The word "Church" (Latin ecclesia, from the Greek ek-ka-lein, to "call out of") means a convocation or an assembly.”

K-4-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “We belong to God’s family” teaches? “She cared for people everyone else forgot, as a mother cares for her family.”
K-4-1.why: Mother Teresa: she cared for people everyone else forgot, as a mother cares for her family.

K-4-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “We belong to God’s family”?
K-4-1.why: Acts 2:42-47 is the passage for this lesson.

K-4-2.q: True or false: The church is God’s house. We are quiet and respectful there because Jesus is present. We find the altar, the cross and the tabernacle.
Which word fits? “The table of sacrifice at the center of the church.”
K-4-2.why: altar: The table of sacrifice at the center of the church.

K-4-2.q: Which word fits? “The place in church where the Blessed Sacrament is kept.”
K-4-2.why: tabernacle: The place in church where the Blessed Sacrament is kept.

K-4-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Our church building” teaches? “A boy who carried Jesus in the Eucharist and protected him.”
K-4-2.why: Tarcisius: a boy who carried Jesus in the Eucharist and protected him.

K-4-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Our church building”?
K-4-2.why: Psalm 122:1 is the passage for this lesson.

K-4-3.q: True or false: On Sunday we go to Mass. We sing, listen, pray and thank God. It is the day of Jesus’ Resurrection.
Which word fits? “The Church’s highest prayer, in which Jesus’ sacrifice is made present and we receive him.”
K-4-3.why: Mass: The Church’s highest prayer, in which Jesus’ sacrifice is made present and we receive him.

K-4-3.q: Which word fits? “The Lord’s Day, when we remember the Resurrection and rest and worship.”
K-4-3.why: Sunday: The Lord’s Day, when we remember the Resurrection and rest and worship.

K-4-3.q: Catechism 2174: “Jesus rose from the dead "on the first day of the week." Because it is the "first day," the day of Christ's _____ recalls the first creation.”
K-4-3.why: CCC 2174: “Jesus rose from the dead "on the first day of the week." Because it is the "first day," the day of Christ's Resurrection recalls the first creation.”

K-4-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “We go to Mass on Sunday” teaches? “A girl who loved Jesus in the Eucharist so much that she longed to receive him.”
K-4-3.why: Bl. Imelda: a girl who loved Jesus in the Eucharist so much that she longed to receive him.

K-4-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “We go to Mass on Sunday”?
K-4-3.why: Psalm 118:24 is the passage for this lesson.

K-5-1.q: True or false: In Baptism, water is poured and God’s family welcomes us. We get a white garment and a candle. God’s life is in us.
Which word fits? “The sacrament of new birth that frees us from sin and makes us God’s children.”
K-5-1.why: Baptism: The sacrament of new birth that frees us from sin and makes us God’s children.

K-5-1.q: Which word fits? “God’s free gift of his own life and help in us.”
K-5-1.why: grace: God’s free gift of his own life and help in us.

K-5-1.q: Catechism 1213: “Holy _____ is the basis of the whole Christian life, the gateway to life in the Spirit (vitae spiritualis ianua), and the door which gives access to the other sacraments.”
K-5-1.why: CCC 1213: “Holy Baptism is the basis of the whole Christian life, the gateway to life in the Spirit (vitae spiritualis ianua), and the door which gives access to the other sacraments.”

K-5-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Baptism makes us God’s children” teaches? “A girl who stayed faithful to Christ; her name means light, like the baptismal candle.”
K-5-1.why: Lucy: a girl who stayed faithful to Christ; her name means light, like the baptismal candle.

K-5-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Baptism makes us God’s children”?
K-5-1.why: Matthew 28:19 is the passage for this lesson.

K-5-2.q: True or false: At Mass, bread and wine become Jesus. He gives himself to us. We prepare our hearts to receive him someday.
Which word fits? “The sacrament of Jesus’ Body and Blood, given to us under the appearances of bread and wine.”
K-5-2.why: Eucharist: The sacrament of Jesus’ Body and Blood, given to us under the appearances of bread and wine.

K-5-2.q: Which word fits? “Jesus is truly, fully present in the Eucharist: body, blood, soul and divinity.”
K-5-2.why: Real Presence: Jesus is truly, fully present in the Eucharist: body, blood, soul and divinity.

K-5-2.q: Catechism 1323: “This he did in order to perpetuate the sacrifice of the cross throughout the ages until he should come again, and so to entrust to his beloved Spouse, the _____, a memorial of his death and resurrection:”
K-5-2.why: CCC 1323: “This he did in order to perpetuate the sacrifice of the cross throughout the ages until he should come again, and so to entrust to his beloved Spouse, the Church, a memorial of his death and resurrection:”

K-5-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The Eucharist is Jesus’ gift” teaches? “A young martyr of the Eucharist.”
K-5-2.why: Tarcisius: a young martyr of the Eucharist.

K-5-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The Eucharist is Jesus’ gift”?
K-5-2.why: Luke 22:19 is the passage for this lesson.

K-5-3.q: True or false: When we do wrong, we can say sorry. God is always ready to forgive. He loves us even when we make mistakes.
Which word fits? “Choosing to do or say something that goes against God’s love and his law.”
K-5-3.why: sin: Choosing to do or say something that goes against God’s love and his law.

K-5-3.q: Which word fits? “Letting go of anger and pardoning someone who hurt us.”
K-5-3.why: forgiveness: Letting go of anger and pardoning someone who hurt us.

K-5-3.q: Catechism 1439: “the beautiful robe, the ring, and the festive banquet are symbols of that new life - pure worthy, and joyful - of anyone who returns to God and to the bosom of his family, which is the _____.”
K-5-3.why: CCC 1439: “the beautiful robe, the ring, and the festive banquet are symbols of that new life - pure worthy, and joyful - of anyone who returns to God and to the bosom of his family, which is the Church.”

K-5-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “God forgives” teaches? “A girl who forgave as she was dying.”
K-5-3.why: Maria Goretti: a girl who forgave as she was dying.

K-5-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “God forgives”?
K-5-3.why: Luke 15:11-24 is the passage for this lesson.

K-6-1.q: True or false: Jesus said to love God and love our neighbor. We show love by being kind, sharing and helping.
Which word fits? “Do to others what you would have them do to you.”
K-6-1.why: Golden Rule: Do to others what you would have them do to you.

K-6-1.q: Which word fits? “Love: wanting what is good for God and for others, and acting on it.”
K-6-1.why: charity: Love: wanting what is good for God and for others, and acting on it.

K-6-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Love God and love others” teaches? “A Peruvian friar who loved the poor and animals.”
K-6-1.why: Martin de Porres: a Peruvian friar who loved the poor and animals.

K-6-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Love God and love others”?
K-6-1.why: Mark 12:29-31 is the passage for this lesson.

K-6-2.q: True or false: God wants us to tell the truth. Lies hurt people. Telling the truth makes us feel free.
Which word fits? “The inner voice of judgment that helps us know right from wrong.”
K-6-2.why: conscience: The inner voice of judgment that helps us know right from wrong.

K-6-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Telling the truth” teaches? “A man who told the truth even when it cost him.”
K-6-2.why: Thomas More: a man who told the truth even when it cost him.

K-6-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Telling the truth”?
K-6-2.why: Exodus 20:16 is the passage for this lesson.

K-6-3.q: True or false: When we hurt someone, we say sorry. When someone hurts us, we forgive. Jesus forgives us, so we can forgive too.
Which word fits? “Letting go of anger and pardoning someone who hurt us.”
K-6-3.why: forgiveness: Letting go of anger and pardoning someone who hurt us.

K-6-3.q: Catechism 2843: “Thus the Lord's words on _____, the love that loves to the end, become a living reality.”
K-6-3.why: CCC 2843: “Thus the Lord's words on forgiveness, the love that loves to the end, become a living reality.”

K-6-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Saying sorry and forgiving” teaches? “She forgave her attacker with her last words.”
K-6-3.why: Maria Goretti: she forgave her attacker with her last words.

K-6-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Saying sorry and forgiving”?
K-6-3.why: Matthew 18:21-22 is the passage for this lesson.

K-7-1.q: True or false: Prayer is talking to God. We can pray with words, with songs or in quiet. God always listens.
Which word fits? “Raising our minds and hearts to God.”
K-7-1.why: prayer: Raising our minds and hearts to God.

K-7-1.q: Catechism 2559: “humility is the foundation of _____, Only when we humbly acknowledge that "we do not know how to pray as we ought," are we ready to receive freely the gift of prayer.”
K-7-1.why: CCC 2559: “humility is the foundation of prayer, Only when we humbly acknowledge that "we do not know how to pray as we ought," are we ready to receive freely the gift of prayer.”

K-7-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “We can talk to God” teaches? “A girl who prayed the Rosary and saw Our Lady at Lourdes.”
K-7-1.why: Bernadette Soubirous: a girl who prayed the Rosary and saw Our Lady at Lourdes.

K-7-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “We can talk to God”?
K-7-1.why: Psalm 5:2-3 is the passage for this lesson.

K-7-2.q: True or false: Jesus taught his friends to pray the Our Father. We pray it every day.
Which word fits? “The prayer Jesus taught us.”
K-7-2.why: Our Father: The prayer Jesus taught us.

K-7-2.q: Catechism 2765: “The traditional expression "the Lord's _____" - oratio Dominica - means that the prayer to our Father is taught and given to us by the Lord Jesus.”
K-7-2.why: CCC 2765: “The traditional expression "the Lord's Prayer" - oratio Dominica - means that the prayer to our Father is taught and given to us by the Lord Jesus.”

K-7-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The Our Father” teaches? “She taught that the Our Father is the best prayer to learn.”
K-7-2.why: Teresa of Avila: she taught that the Our Father is the best prayer to learn.

K-7-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The Our Father”?
K-7-2.why: Matthew 6:9-13 is the passage for this lesson.

K-7-3.q: True or false: We begin and end prayer with the Sign of the Cross. We thank God before meals.
Which word fits? “Prayer that gives glory to God for who he is.”
K-7-3.why: praise: Prayer that gives glory to God for who he is.

K-7-3.q: Which word fits? “Thanking God for his gifts.”
K-7-3.why: thanksgiving: Thanking God for his gifts.

K-7-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The Sign of the Cross and Grace” teaches? “A kitchen worker who prayed while washing pots.”
K-7-3.why: Brother Lawrence: a kitchen worker who prayed while washing pots.

K-7-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The Sign of the Cross and Grace”?
K-7-3.why: Matthew 28:19 is the passage for this lesson.

K-8-1.q: True or false: Advent is a time to get ready for Christmas. We light candles on the Advent wreath and wait with joy.
Which word fits? “The season of preparing for Christmas.”
K-8-1.why: Advent: The season of preparing for Christmas.

K-8-1.q: Catechism 524: “By celebrating the precursor's birth and martyrdom, the _____ unites herself to his desire:”
K-8-1.why: CCC 524: “By celebrating the precursor's birth and martyrdom, the Church unites herself to his desire:”

K-8-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Advent: waiting for Jesus” teaches? “He told people to get ready for Jesus.”
K-8-1.why: John the Baptist: he told people to get ready for Jesus.

K-8-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Advent: waiting for Jesus”?
K-8-1.why: Isaiah 9:1-2 is the passage for this lesson.

K-8-2.q: True or false: Lent is a time to pray and share. Easter is a time of joy because Jesus rose.
Which word fits? “The forty days of prayer, fasting and almsgiving before Easter.”
K-8-2.why: Lent: The forty days of prayer, fasting and almsgiving before Easter.

K-8-2.q: Which word fits? “The feast of Jesus’ Resurrection, the greatest feast of the year.”
K-8-2.why: Easter: The feast of Jesus’ Resurrection, the greatest feast of the year.

K-8-2.q: Catechism 1169: “Therefore _____ is not simply one feast among others, but the "Feast of feasts," the "Solemnity of solemnities," just as the Eucharist is the "Sacrament of sacraments" (the Great Sacrament).”
K-8-2.why: CCC 1169: “Therefore Easter is not simply one feast among others, but the "Feast of feasts," the "Solemnity of solemnities," just as the Eucharist is the "Sacrament of sacraments" (the Great Sacrament).”

K-8-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Lent and Easter” teaches? “He gave up everything to follow Jesus and care for the poor.”
K-8-2.why: Francis of Assisi: he gave up everything to follow Jesus and care for the poor.

K-8-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Lent and Easter”?
K-8-2.why: Luke 24:1-12 is the passage for this lesson.

K-8-3.q: True or false: Ordinary Time is the time of green, when we grow like plants in God’s love.
Which word fits? “The green weeks of the year when we follow Jesus’ life and teaching.”
K-8-3.why: Ordinary Time: The green weeks of the year when we follow Jesus’ life and teaching.

K-8-3.q: Which word fits? “Being thankful for gifts.”
Catechism 1163: “"Holy Mother _____ believes that she should celebrate the saving work of her divine Spouse in a sacred commemoration on certain days throughout the course of the year.”
K-8-3.why: CCC 1163: “"Holy Mother Church believes that she should celebrate the saving work of her divine Spouse in a sacred commemoration on certain days throughout the course of the year.”

K-8-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Ordinary Time and Thank You” teaches? “She called herself a “little flower” and taught the little way of love.”
K-8-3.why: Thérèse of Lisieux: she called herself a “little flower” and taught the little way of love.

K-8-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Ordinary Time and Thank You”?
K-8-3.why: Psalm 1:3 is the passage for this lesson.
